component.name: THR Control
component.summary: Unofficial editor for Yamaha THR guitar amplifiers

description.p: THR Control edits Yamaha THR guitar amplifiers (first generation, tested on a THR5 with THR5 V2 firmware) over USB, without the official editor.

ul.li: Live two-way control of amp model, gain, master, EQ, cabinet and all effects
A preset library with search, genres, favorites, notes, import and export
Tempo-synced delay, a live frequency-response plot and a recorder that saves dry and processed tracks
Safe by design: the app never sends firmware or bootloader commands

description.p: This is an independent project. Yamaha and THR are trademarks of their owner.
